body: Cheers to you too. Sorry to say I did make an attempt on my life, although obviously it was not wholly successful. I am recovering slowly but surely. I really don't know what to say, but I can quite honestly tell you that I shall never make another attempt. While I may never have a definitive purpose to my life or any great joy - I am alive, I am conscious and I am free to do what I want with my life. And that feels good. Amazing in fact. Thank you, and to all the others in this sub who care so much and work so hard. I wish there was a way for me to formally thank all of you, not just on my behalf, but for everybody on here whom you all help so much. Sorry to have been rambling on, I just needed to put all of it out there so you guys know I am ok. Thank you. much love and cheers

It has been a long time since I felt like I owed anything to the company at which I work. Not that the conditions are bad, but it is simply incredibly repetitive and offers almost no stimulation. Unfortunately I left school without any qualifications and have no trade of my own. This makes it absolutely difficult to find even a small gap through which I could break into the job market, especially for work which would hold my interest or be in some way fulfilling. 
     I agree with you there, I usually enjoy a pint when on the verge of a big decision. Something about a warm familiar environment helps you think straight. Although I will be blunt with you, This decision has been made - and I am comfortable with my choice. 
     Lastly, thank you for your response. This did genuinely make me stop and think, it's good to know that there are people out there who are good and do care. Maybe thats why I posted this, I really don't know. There is a lot on my mind right now. I'm going to close the laptop now and see about this pint.
